svg.aria-label: Self-service ordering: the kiosk journey with a foyer host
svg.text: Self-service ordering: the kiosk journey with a foyer host
Five stages from the door to the hand-off, with the foyer host as its own frontstage lane. The measures
lane says what counts as done; the failure points are where the channel broke before the role existed.
KFC South Pacific, 2023 to 2024. Drawn by Sam Mozaffari from the work's order workflow; vendors, sites and people removed. Rendered September 2026.
